item.title: Marvel Officially Confirms New Avengers Team for Doomsday
item.description: The Marvel Cinematic Universe 's Avengers lineup has been a bit muddled since the events of Captain America: Civil War , which broke up the team of besties. Things got more confusing when the team of misfits in last year's Thunderbolts* was declared the New Avengers at the end of the film, causing a bit of a kerfuffle between the team and Anthony Mackie's Sam Wilson/Captain America over who gets to call themselves Avengers.

item.title: Cities: Skylines' Best Replacement Is Finally Here and Better than Expected
item.description: 2026 is the year I got massively into city builders, and by massively I mean I played Cities: Skylines more than anything else for the first half of the year. I started dabbling with city builder-slash-logistics games in the second half of the year, like Anno 117 , and turned my attention to Transport Fever 3 soon after. When I first learned about Transport Fever 3 , I called it "like" Cities: Skylines . It looked a lot like a traditional city builder, albeit one where you focus on roads more than zoning. After playing it over the last month or so, though, I realize the difference between city builder and logistics planner is a lot more distinct than I initially gave it credit for — and I've irreversibly become a logistics sicko.

item.title: 8 New TV Shows to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO (November 13-15)
item.description: It’s a big weekend for new TV. VisionQuest has concluded its first season, including a post-credits scene with big implications for Avengers: Doomsday . The Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power is back with a third season, continuing the story of a Middle-earth set thousands of years before Bilbo and Frodo Baggins. The Body is also available on Netflix, delivering a fun and campy high school drama with some religious horror thrown in the mix.

item.title: Blood of Dawnwalker Finally Gets Its Most Requested Feature Next Week
item.description: It's been just over two months since The Blood of Dawnwalker was released and fans have been clamoring for one missing feature for basically that long. Now developer Rebel Wolves is set to appease that demand with the upcoming update 1.2. Yes, New Game Plus is going to be a reality for the vampire RPG.

item.title: Costco’s New 'Pokémon' 30th Anniversary Online TCG Bundle Is Unbelievable
item.description: Warehouse retailer Costco is determined to blow its competitors out of the water when it comes to selling Pokémon Trading Card Game products. A couple of months after debuting the best Pokémon deal of 2026 , the members-only retailer is back with another offer that sounds too good to be true. This time, Costco's promotion targets Pokémon collectors hunting for the elusive 30th Anniversary collection . The best part? You won't have to set foot in a Costco store to take advantage of the promotion.

item.title: The Game Awards 2026 Nominees Announcement Confirmed for Nov. 17
item.description: The Game Awards 2026 is approaching, and this year's award nominees are set to be announced on Tuesday, Nov. 17. That's according to host and creator of The Game Awards Geoff Keighley, who announced Friday that 2026's nominees will be revealed during a livestream — that just happens to be coming two days ahead of the year's most anticipated game, Grand Theft Auto 6 .

item.title: Every Free Game You Can Keep on Steam, Epic, PlayStation Plus, and Xbox (Nov. 13-19)
item.description: Next week the world will stop for many players with the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 . If you've already preloaded GTA 6 , then you'll be ready to hit "Play" as soon as it becomes available on Nov. 19. In the meantime, you have to find a game that'll keep you busy.

item.title: Magic Just Revealed 19 New Cards From 2027’s First Set — Including a $30 Reprint With Stunning Art
item.description: Magic: The Gathering is heading underwater, and we’ve just gotten a closer look at what’s lurking in the depths of a new plane called Nauctis. During Friday’s preview panel at MagicCon : Atlanta, Wizards of the Coast revealed 19 cards from Nauctis: The Sunken Realm (including different art variants), the upcoming set that introduces an ocean plane to Magic ’s Multiverse. Launching on Feb. 5, 2027, the set trades typical fantasy settings like Dominaria or Ikoria for sprawling underwater cities and aquatic creatures, with greater dangers waiting farther below the surface.

item.title: How Queen's Domain's 2-Person Team Remade Elden Ring's Legacy in a Basement
item.description: At Final Strike Games, Berger met Bradley Boothe, a technical artist and former software engineer who shared a frustration with what could get done at a traditional studio. Together, they struck out on their own, founding the two-person indie studio Freshly Baked Games and trading the security of industry jobs for the creative freedom — and financial uncertainty — of building something entirely theirs. Many years later, the result was a prototype for a game… that was way too ambitious (but they fully intend to return to). So they went back to a different concept, a stripped-down first-person fantasy inspired by FromSoftware's cult-classic King's Field . That was supposed to take a year to build. Three years later, the game, Queen’s Domain , is an ambitious torrent of weaponry, monster encounters, and Berger’s patented 3D level design, all spread across an low-poly open-world map.
